sentences.text: Daybeacons are fixed aids, dayboards mounted on piles, common in Florida bays and along the Intracoastal Waterway.
Red daybeacons are triangles with even numbers, and green daybeacons are squares with odd numbers, following the same red right returning rule.
Because daybeacons are fixed, they’re more reliable in position than buoys.
But they often stand in shallow water right at the edge of a channel, so give them a reasonable berth rather than cutting close.
